ITEM 1 | Pale cream-white florets clustered in a loose heap on the left half of the plate, soft-looking with slightly matte surface, some florets with small stem pieces, moist but not flowing, holding a mound about 9 cm across and 3 cm high | 150
ITEM 2 | Breaded piece with golden-brown crumb coating (fine granular, sesame-like specks), sitting at the upper right of the plate, roughly 6 cm by 4 cm, with an orange-red glossy glaze on its surface and green flecks | 90
ITEM 3 | Pale pinkish-cream meat portion with a crumbly golden-brown crust coating and visible inner fibrous texture, about 7 cm by 4 cm and 1.5 cm thick, slightly moist surface, lying center-right beside the glazed piece | 85
ITEM 4 | Small scattered crumbs and bits of golden-brown breading and dark flecks around the bottom of the meat portion, loose and dry, covering about 3 cm by 2 cm | 8
ITEM 5 | Single small green leaf fragment, flat and bright green, about 1 cm long, lying on the plate near the bottom center | 1
